# Partha Chakraborty

> Applied Scientist building retrieval and ranking systems at scale. Work sits at the intersection of classical information retrieval and modern neural approaches.

## About

Partha Chakraborty is an Applied Scientist at Coalition Inc. (Ontario, Canada), where he builds enterprise search and knowledge retrieval infrastructure. His work covers production hybrid search systems, fine-tuned bi-encoder models for semantic entity resolution, and evaluation platforms that track both classical IR metrics (MAP, MRR, nDCG) and LLM-based quality signals.

Previously: Deep Learning Engineer at Huawei Canada (vision-language models), Applied Scientist II Intern at Amazon Advertising (learning-to-rank across 21 marketplaces), Software Engineer at Dingi Technologies (personalized search and POI retrieval). PhD in Computer Science from the University of Waterloo (2024), specializing in AI with a focus on automated bug localization.

## Research

- **Search & Ranking**: learning-to-rank, hybrid retrieval, dense/sparse signal fusion, relevance evaluation
- **Representation Learning**: bi-encoder and cross-encoder training, hard negative mining, domain adaptation for embeddings
- **Production AI Systems**: RAG pipelines, LLM-based agents, evaluation infrastructure

## Selected Work

- **BLAZE** (TSE 2025): zero-shot hybrid retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and in-batch hard negative mining. Outperforms OpenAI gen-3 embeddings by up to 38% on bug localization benchmarks.
- **RLocator** (TSE 2024): actor-critic reinforcement learning for learning-to-rank on bug reports. +13% MAP over BM25 and neural baselines.
- **Embedding Design Choices** (NLBSE 2024): evaluated 32 bi-encoder configurations; adversarial training outperforms architecture changes for code-text retrieval.
- **Vulnerability Detection on Realistic Datasets** (TSE 2024): dataset curation bias study; corrected dataset improves model generalization by 30%.

## Skills

Python, PyTorch, Sentence Transformers, Milvus, Elasticsearch, hybrid search, BM25, dense retrieval, RRF, bi-encoders, cross-encoders, hard negative mining, RAG, MAP/MRR/nDCG evaluation, AWS, SageMaker, Docker.
